en.headline: Lee urges media to tell good stories of Hong Kong and nation
en.dek: At a National Day reception for the press, the Chief Executive said the government would keep helping local outlets expand their international reach.
body: Chief Executive John Lee on Tuesday urged the media to report objectively and fairly so as to drive society forward, while also serving as messengers who tell the good stories of the nation and of Hong Kong.

Speaking at a reception held by the media sector to mark the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic of China, Lee said the SAR government would continue to assist local media in enhancing their competitiveness and expanding networks beyond Hong Kong.

He noted that Hong Kong’s first five-year plan had already called for strengthening the global reach of mainstream media, and that this year’s Policy Address reiterated the government’s support for local outlets to raise their international communication capacity.

Lee described the press as a transmitter of public sentiment that also guides people’s hearts and minds. He called on professional journalists to uphold ethics when reporting the facts, remain objective and balanced, and stay alert to risks that could affect social stability.

zh.headline: 李家超籲新聞界客觀報道 擔當國家及香港好故事發聲人
zh.dek: 行政長官出席新聞界國慶活動，表示政府會繼續協助本地傳媒提升競爭力及國際傳播力。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二出席新聞界慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年活動時表示，期望新聞界以客觀公正報道推動社會進步，同時擔當國家及香港好故事的發聲人。
他指出，特區政府會繼續協助本地傳媒提升競爭力，並擴大香港以外的網絡。香港首個五年規劃已提出加強主流媒體的國際傳播能力，今年施政報告亦重申政府會繼續支援本地傳媒發展。
李家超形容傳媒既是民情的傳播器，也是民心的引路燈，專業新聞工作者應堅守報道事實的職業道德，秉持客觀、公正及持平精神，時刻警惕可能影響社會穩定的風險隱患。
他期望新聞界透過客觀公正的報道，向世界傳遞國家及香港真實的好故事，讓更多人認識一國兩制下香港作為超級聯繫人及超級增值人所帶來的機遇。
